title: ReviewDecision
description: A submitted review decision for one item. Distinct from transient /save diff payloads. This is the final decision shape written on /submit.

item_id.description: The ReviewItem.item_id this decision applies to.

reject_reason.description: Reason for rejection. Null if accepted or pending.

edited_caption.description: User-edited caption text. Null if unchanged.

reviewed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this item was reviewed.

state_version.description: The run-state version at the time this decision was made. Used for stale-save detection.
